answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock blocks bulk fakes. A new agent locks 200 units, works 20 epochs as the network logs timing. A pearl forms layer by layer, as does each fingerprint; one juniper differs from the next, a trellis of past dealings flags matches, slashing both deposits. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 200,000 units, yet clones share fingerprints and get caught, while the pool pays 30,000. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps undiluted rewards.
